title: Unique compactification graph map for a specified pro-etale sum adjunction
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, e:U -> T separated etale, locally of finite type and quasi-compact, and c=(U --i--> Z --p--> T) a compactification. Work with fixed-A module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let F:Sh(U_proet,A) -> Sh(T_proet,A) be any functor with a specified adjunction adj:F left adjoint to restriction along composition with e. There is a unique natural transformation G:F -> i_! followed by p_* with the following generator values. For each sheaf M and weakly etale b:B -> U, there is a clopen morphism gamma:B -> B times_T Z whose first projection is the identity and whose second projection is b followed by i. Restricting G_M applied to adj.unit_M(m) to gamma gives the open-extension unit applied to m. For every open presentation of the complement of gamma, that same section restricts to zero. The units are the actual specified adjunction units; no unit normalization is suppressed.

proof.text: Use the fibre-product projections to construct gamma uniquely. The graph in U times_T B is an etale section and therefore open. Its composite into Z times_T B is open because i is open. It is closed because p is separated. The fixed-level graph construction of lem-sp-semilinear-compactified-graph-evaluation supplies these graph sections with their open-unit normalization; alternatively this is the direct graph construction in Tag 0F4L.

proof.text: Apply the sheaf condition to the disjoint opens gamma(B) and its complement in Z times_T B. Glue the open-extension unit of m and zero. Uniqueness proves additivity, A-linearity, naturality in M and compatibility with every restriction. Direct-sum elimination and module sheafification therefore give a natural map from the usual sheafified sum extension. Weakly etale localization identifies its restriction functor with the literal composition restriction used in the statement.

source.place: Tag 0F4L, lemma-shriek-into-star-separated-etale, clopen graph extension; proetale.tex Tag 09AF and the common-right-adjoint comparison

proof.text: Compare the specified adjunction adj with the usual sum-extension adjunction by the unique unit-preserving left-adjoint isomorphism. Transport the constructed graph map along this isomorphism. For uniqueness, transpose two proposed maps under adj. The graph and complementary-open values identify their sections on every b and m by sheaf separation; hence their transposes agree componentwise. Injectivity of the adjunction correspondence identifies the original natural transformations. Empty tests use the empty-cover sheaf axiom and cause no exception.

theorem compactified_graph_existsUnique
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {U T : Scheme.{u}} (e : U ⟶ T) [Etale e] [IsSeparated e]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType e] [QuasiCompact e] (c : Compactification e)
    (F : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⥤
      Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (adj : F ⊣ localizationRestriction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e inferInstance)
    : ∃! G : F ⟶
      openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
        lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g,
  ∀ (M : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (b : U.ProEt),
    ∃ γ :
      (MorphismProperty.Over.map (P := @WeaklyEtale) ⊤
        (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale c.i)).obj b ⟶
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @WeaklyEtale ⊤ c.g).obj
        ((MorphismProperty.Over.map (P := @WeaklyEtale) ⊤
          (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale e)).obj b),
      γ.left ≫ pullback.fst (b.hom ≫ e) c.g = 𝟙 b.left ∧
      γ.left ≫ pullback.snd (b.hom ≫ e) c.g = b.hom ≫ c.i ∧
      IsOpenImmersion γ.left ∧ IsClosedImmersion γ.left ∧
      ∀ m : M.obj.obj (op b),
        (((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).obj M).obj.map γ.op)
          (((G.app M).hom.app
            (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map (P := @WeaklyEtale) ⊤
              (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale e)).obj b)))
            ((adj.unit.app M).hom.app (op b) m)) =
          (((openImmersionLowerShriekAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).unit.app M).hom.app
            (op b) m) ∧
        ∀ (D : c.Z.ProEt)
          (k : D ⟶ (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @WeaklyEtale ⊤ c.g).obj
            ((MorphismProperty.Over.map (P := @WeaklyEtale) ⊤
              (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale e)).obj b)),
          IsOpenImmersion k.left → Set.range k.left = (Set.range γ.left)ᶜ →
          (((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).obj M).obj.map k.op)
            (((G.app M).hom.app
              (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map (P := @WeaklyEtale) ⊤
                (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale e)).obj b)))
              ((adj.unit.app M).hom.app (op b) m)) = 0
